why: No patched version exists: braces 3.0.3 is the latest release and the advisory covers every version up to it. stylelint and purgecss reach it through micromatch and fast-glob, and their latest releases still do.
exposure: Build-time tooling only: stylelint and the CSS build's purgecss. The only patterns that reach braces are our own, the lint:styles glob and purgecss's content setting. No customer, request or function input reaches it, and none of it ships to the browser or the Netlify functions. The worst case is a crashed lint or build on a pattern we wrote.
plan: Take the fix when braces or micromatch ships one. bin/audit/check.mjs and the daily production audit fail once the advisory database names a patched braces, with no manual step.
